author: Paul Hess
title: Danville man arrested in domestic-related shooting - NewsBreak
text:
By Paul Hess Getty Images ,
2 days ago
DANVILLE, Va. ( WFXR )- A Danville man was arrested for allegedly shooting his adult son in the leg.
The shooting happened in the early morning hours on Sunday, July 26 in the area of Newton and Craghead streets, according to the Danville Police Department. The victim, a 26-year-old Danville resident, was treated and released from the hospital
Derrick Brown, 47, was arrested during a traffic stop by the Georgia State Patrol.
Teen faces charges for $60K worth of alleged thefts, damages in Rockbridge County Brown is awaiting extradition on the following charges:
Malicious wounding Reckless handling of a firearm Discharging a firearm in public space Possession of a firearm by a violent convicted felon Use of a firearm in the commission of a felony Copyright 2026 Nexstar Media, Inc.
